fields.label: Last Event Seq
fields.description: Last event sequence number delivered to this vendor for idempotency

fields.label: Last Processed Event Seq
fields.description: Highest event_seq successfully delivered to this vendor, in order. Used to hold later-sequenced events until earlier gaps are filled — see api/event_ordering.py.

fields.label: Clock Skew (seconds)
fields.description: Measured difference between this vendor's clock and the hub's, from inbound request timestamps. Positive = vendor ahead. Widens the HMAC timestamp tolerance for this vendor — see api/clock_sync.py.

fields.label: Error Count (DB Fallback)
fields.description: Delivery error counter used only when Redis is unavailable — see api/partial_failure.py._db_record_error. Not the live error-budget counter (that lives in cache).

fields.label: Webhook Secret
fields.description: Per-vendor HMAC secret for inbound webhook authentication. Leave blank to use the global Settings secret.

fields.label: Previous Webhook Secret
fields.description: Accepted (never sent) during rotation so the secret can be swapped with zero downtime.

fields.label: Webhook Secret Last Rotated
fields.description: Set by api/secret_rotation.py:rotate_vendor_secret on success. Blank means never rotated since this field was added — api/secret_rotation.py:check_stale_secrets treats that as due, using the vendor's creation date as the baseline.

fields.label: Setup Instructions
fields.description: Auto-generated on creation. Copy these values to the vendor's Frappe site: Site URL, API Key, API Secret, and Webhook Secret.

fields.label: Warehouses
fields.description: Physical warehouse locations for this vendor. Used for multi-location stock and nearest-warehouse routing.

fields.label: Default Warehouse Name
fields.description: Read-only: auto-populated from the warehouse marked as default. Fallback when no warehouse is specified.
